2608.21292.title: AUSO: Action-Level Unified Skill Optimization from Internalization to Utilization
2608.21292.paper_summary: Skills play different roles as an agent's policy evolves: they should first provide learnable knowledge, then support capability formation, and finally be invoked only when they improve individual decisions. Existing methods rarely model this lifecycle. They either keep skills outside the model, fully internalize them, or select among internalization and utilization objectives through noisy task-level success rates. Such designs fragment training and assign uniform importance to actions within the same trajectory, even though skill guidance may help some decisions while distracting others. To solve these problems, we introduce AUSO (Action-level Unified Skill Optimization), which unifies skill learning and skill use through a progressive, action-aware optimization process. At the beginning of training, AUSO jointly learns from teacher guidance and environmental outcomes, enabling the policy to acquire foundational skills without losing task-oriented feedback. It subsequently emphasizes outcome-based policy optimization to consolidate autonomous problem-solving ability. As the policy matures, AUSO evaluates each sampled action under both skill-conditioned and skill-free contexts. The resulting action-level information signal is coupled with the trajectory outcome advantage, allowing beneficial skill-sensitive actions to receive stronger updates and harmful ones to be suppressed. Therefore, skills gradually transition from an external source of supervision into decision knowledge whose utilization is adapted to its action-level benefit, while reinforcement learning remains the shared backbone across all stages. Experiments on ALFWorld, WebShop, and SearchQA show that AUSO consistently improves agent performance and out-of-distribution generalization over competitive baselines.
2608.21292.paper_summary_zh: 技能在代理的策略演變中扮演著不同的角色：它們首先應提供可學習的知識，然後支持能力的形成，最後僅在能改善個人決策時被調用。現有的方法很少對這一生命周期進行建模。它們要麼將技能置於模型之外，要麼完全內化它們，或者通過嘈雜的任務級成功率在內化和利用目標之間進行選擇。這樣的設計使訓練變得零散，並對同一軌跡中的行動賦予統一的重要性，儘管技能指導可能有助於某些決策，而分散注意力於其他決策。為了解決這些問題，我們引入了AUSO（行動級統一技能優化），它通過一個漸進的、行動感知的優化過程來統一技能學習和技能使用。在訓練開始時，AUSO同時從教師指導和環境結果中學習，使策略能夠獲得基礎技能而不失去以任務為導向的反饋。隨後，它強調基於結果的策略優化，以鞏固自主解決問題的能力。隨著策略的成熟，AUSO在技能條件和無技能條件的上下文中評估每個採樣的行動。產生的行動級信息信號與軌跡結果優勢相結合，允許有利的技能敏感行動獲得更強的更新，而有害的行動則受到抑制。因此，技能逐漸從外部監督源轉變為決策知識，其利用適應於其行動級的利益，而強化學習則在所有階段中保持共同的支柱。在ALFWorld、WebShop和SearchQA上的實驗顯示，AUSO始終能夠提高代理的性能和超出分佈的泛化能力，超越競爭基準。
